description: Ask the market how a buy would be filled: a plain new order, buying more only, or extending existing delegations (optionally plus extra). Returns each option with `readyToFill` (percent), `payout` (SUN) and the `extendData` rows. Use before `tronsave_create_order` when the receiver may already have delegations that can be extended cheaper. Public, read-only. Prices move every ~3 s: re-run right before ordering.

receiver.description: TRON base58 address that will receive the resource.

requester.description: TRON base58 address that pays; defaults to the logged-in wallet.

unitPrice.description: Unit price in SUN you are willing to pay.

name: tronsave_suggest_create_order
title: Suggest Order Strategy
